combination: u = normalize(m + b * evasion_component); b = 0 -> env u_base bit-for-bit

gates.G1: per level pooled collisions(candidate) <= collisions(BASE); matched gained collisions == 0
gates.G2: per level exhausted/timeout/orbit/ceiling-hover/sustained-hover <= BASE; overshoot-episode fraction <= BASE + 0.5pp
gates.G3: >=5% episodes diverge >=1 m AND (>=10 interception->capture conversions OR |mean min-sep diff|>=0.25 m); positive: conversions >= reversals
gates.G6: evasion precedes frozen planner, suppressed when planner owns steering, no gained collision within 3 steps of executed evasion

gating: executed blend forced to 0 when true defender range > enemy_defender_detection_range (A1 observation gate); suppressed when the frozen common layer owns steering
selection: smallest useful set (BASE+LOW+HIGH only if distinct), no redundant strengths
